test_title: PYST 37: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 21 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

I found my neighbour frequently __**upbraiding**__ his 5-year-old son for being playful all the time.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (extolling)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"upbraiding"** means scolding, criticising, or reproaching someone harshly, especially for wrongdoing or bad behavior. (फटकारना)

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher was upbraiding the student for not completing the homework on time.
 
 
 
• **"Extolling"** refers to praising or glorifying someone or something enthusiastically. (प्रशंसा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The coach was extolling the team for their outstanding performance in the tournament.
 
 
 
• The antonym of "upbraiding" (scolding or criticising) is "extolling" (praising or glorifying).

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (extolling)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Beating** (मारना): Hitting someone repeatedly to cause physical harm.

 
 
• **Example:** The boxer received a beating during the intense match.
 
 
 
• **Blaming** (दोष देना): Assigning responsibility for a fault or wrong to someone.
 
 
• **Example:** Instead of solving the issue, they kept blaming each other for the mistake.
 
 
 
• **Criticising** (आलोचना करना): Finding faults in someone or something in a disapproving way.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager kept criticising the new employee's work instead of providing constructive feedback.
 
 

3d:T893,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.<
